$schema.description: JSON schema of this file, for editor completion and validation.
$schema.markdownDescription: JSON schema of this file, for editor completion and validation.

model.description:
Model the agents use: any model pattern your pi setup resolves, including models from pi packages that register a provider. Unset: your pi default model.

CLI: --model
model.markdownDescription:
Model the agents use: any model pattern your pi setup resolves, including models from pi packages that register a provider. Unset: your pi default model.

CLI: `--model`

enumDescriptions: The least thinking the model supports.
The default here: judgments hold up and output stays small.
pi's own default. More thinking tokens per file than low.
More thinking per file, at more cost.
More thinking per file, at more cost.
The most thinking the model supports.
markdownEnumDescriptions: The least thinking the model supports.
The default here: judgments hold up and output stays small.
pi's own default. More thinking tokens per file than `low`.
More thinking per file, at more cost.
More thinking per file, at more cost.

thinking.description:
Thinking level of the agents. Thinking is billed as output tokens, so higher levels cost more per file.

CLI: --thinking · Default: "low"
thinking.markdownDescription:
Thinking level of the agents. Thinking is billed as output tokens, so higher levels cost more per file.

CLI: `--thinking` · Default: `"low"`

concurrency.description:
Maximum agents running at once. Never more than there are groups. Cost per file does not depend on it; lower it if your provider rate-limits you.

CLI: --concurrency · Default: 32
concurrency.markdownDescription:
Maximum agents running at once. Never more than there are groups. Cost per file does not depend on it; lower it if your provider rate-limits you.

CLI: `--concurrency` · Default: `32`

instructions.description:
Markdown file with your project's rules, appended to the rubric: areas that are always protected, patterns you always keep, tests you disagree with. Relative to the project root. Changing it makes earlier results stale.

CLI: --instructions
instructions.markdownDescription:
Markdown file with your project's rules, appended to the rubric: areas that are always protected, patterns you always keep, tests you disagree with. Relative to the project root. Changing it makes earlier results stale.

CLI: `--instructions`

items.description: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. packages/*/test/**.
items.markdownDescription: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. `packages/*/test/**`.

include.description:
Only consider files matching one of these globs. Unset: every file.

CLI: --include
include.markdownDescription:
Only consider files matching one of these globs. Unset: every file.

CLI: `--include`

items.description: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. packages/*/test/**.
items.markdownDescription: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. `packages/*/test/**`.

exclude.description:
Skip files matching these globs, on top of the built-in excludes (node_modules, dist, build, target, virtual environments and the like). Files ignored by git are always skipped.

CLI: --exclude
exclude.markdownDescription:
Skip files matching these globs, on top of the built-in excludes (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `target`, virtual environments and the like). Files ignored by git are always skipped.

CLI: `--exclude`

budget.description:
Target tokens of test code per group. Each group is one agent session.

CLI: --budget · Default: 50000
budget.markdownDescription:
Target tokens of test code per group. Each group is one agent session.

CLI: `--budget` · Default: `50000`

minGroup.description:
Groups smaller than this are merged with a neighbor when possible.

CLI: --min-group · Default: 15000
minGroup.markdownDescription:
Groups smaller than this are merged with a neighbor when possible.

CLI: `--min-group` · Default: `15000`

tolerance.description:
How far a group may go over budget, as a fraction. 0.1 allows 10% more.

CLI: --tolerance · Default: 0.1
tolerance.markdownDescription:
How far a group may go over `budget`, as a fraction. `0.1` allows 10% more.

CLI: `--tolerance` · Default: `0.1`

outDir.description:
Directory for the plan, results, agent sessions and reports, relative to the project root. It gets its own .gitignore.

CLI: --out · Default: ".tests-diet"
outDir.markdownDescription:
Directory for the plan, results, agent sessions and reports, relative to the project root. It gets its own `.gitignore`.

CLI: `--out` · Default: `".tests-diet"`

name.description: Language name shown in plans and reports, e.g. my-dsl.
name.markdownDescription: Language name shown in plans and reports, e.g. `my-dsl`.

items.description: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. packages/*/test/**.
items.markdownDescription: A glob relative to the project root, e.g. `packages/*/test/**`.

include.description: Files matching any of these globs belong to the language.
include.markdownDescription: Files matching any of these globs belong to the language.

contains.description:
Only files whose content matches this regex (multiline). Use it when a glob alone also matches helpers, e.g. Rust files that contain #[test].

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (\\s).
contains.markdownDescription:
Only files whose content matches this regex (multiline). Use it when a glob alone also matches helpers, e.g. Rust files that contain `#[test]`.

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (`\\s`).

inline.description:
Matched files are production code with tests embedded (Rust #[cfg(test)] modules). They are pruned case by case and never deleted as a whole.

Default: false
inline.markdownDescription:
Matched files are production code with tests embedded (Rust `#[cfg(test)]` modules). They are pruned case by case and never deleted as a whole.

Default: `false`

items.description: Which files belong to the language.
items.markdownDescription: Which files belong to the language.

matchers.description: A file belongs to the language when any matcher accepts it. The first matching language wins.
matchers.markdownDescription: A file belongs to the language when any matcher accepts it. The first matching language wins.

caseStart.description:
Matches the line where a test case starts. Agents get the list of cases and must report each one. Without it, agents find cases on their own and files are never deleted as a whole.

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (\\s).
caseStart.markdownDescription:
Matches the line where a test case starts. Agents get the list of cases and must report each one. Without it, agents find cases on their own and files are never deleted as a whole.

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (`\\s`).

attribute.description:
Matches decorator or attribute lines that belong to the case below them (@pytest.mark..., #[ignore], [Theory]). A case starts at its first such line, so deleting it never leaves a decorator behind.

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (\\s).
attribute.markdownDescription:
Matches decorator or attribute lines that belong to the case below them (`@pytest.mark...`, `#[ignore]`, `[Theory]`). A case starts at its first such line, so deleting it never leaves a decorator behind.

A JavaScript regular expression source; escape backslashes in JSON (`\\s`).

blockComments.description:
Ignore /* ... */ comments when looking for cases, so commented-out tests are not detected.

Default: false
blockComments.markdownDescription:
Ignore `/* ... */` comments when looking for cases, so commented-out tests are not detected.

Default: `false`

enumDescriptions: The case ends where its ()/{} brackets balance again.

mcpServers.description:
MCP servers for the agents only; your personal mcp.json is not loaded. Their tools must also be listed in tools. See Serena for a recommended setup.

CLI: --mcp-config <file>
mcpServers.markdownDescription:
MCP servers for the agents only; your personal `mcp.json` is not loaded. Their tools must also be listed in `tools`. See [Serena](https://github.com/arthurfiorette/tests-diet#recommended-serena) for a recommended setup.

CLI: `--mcp-config <file>`

items.description: A tool name, or a pattern where * matches any characters.
items.markdownDescription: A tool name, or a pattern where `*` matches any characters.

tools.description:
Extra tools the agents may call. read, grep, find and ls are always available. Never allow tools that edit files.

CLI: --tools
tools.markdownDescription:
Extra tools the agents may call. `read`, `grep`, `find` and `ls` are always available. Never allow tools that edit files.

CLI: `--tools`

items.description: Path to a pi extension file, relative to the project root.
items.markdownDescription: Path to a pi extension file, relative to the project root.

extensions.description:
Extra pi extensions loaded in every agent session.

CLI: --extension
extensions.markdownDescription:

pi config directory for the agents: settings, credentials, models and packages. Unset: pi's own (~/.pi/agent).

CLI: --agent-dir

pi config directory for the agents: settings, credentials, models and packages. Unset: pi's own (`~/.pi/agent`).

trustProject.description:
Load the audited project's .pi settings, packages and extensions. Off by default, so the audited code cannot change how the agents run.

CLI: --trust-project · Default: false

maxRejections.description:
Rejected reports tolerated per file before the file is marked failed.

Default: 3
maxRejections.markdownDescription:

maxIdleTurns.description:
Agent turns without an accepted report before the group's session is stopped.

Default: 25
maxIdleTurns.markdownDescription:

Default: `25`
